analysis_label: post-hoc sensitivity of the saved designed surrogate pool

provenance.budget_basis: supplied fixed attempted trial count, including source skips and failures

outcome_definitions.macro_conditional_verified_flip_rate: Per model, the equal-recipe mean of true_target_flips divided by source-successful target_original_injection counts. Zero-baseline recipes are undefined and omitted; a model with no defined recipes is undefined.
outcome_definitions.source_success_gated_verified_flip_yield: Verified target flips after source success divided by all attempted model-recipe trials, including source failures and skipped baselines. Failed-source perturbations were not target-audited.

statistical_interpretation: Model rows are units of a designed pool. Association p-values condition on an exchangeability null for complete-case model rows. These post-hoc, multiple analyses are exploratory and do not validate a population predictor or selection rule. Leave-one-out ranges and subset fractions are descriptive.
limitations: Repeated originals and perturbations across models and recipes are overlapping records.
Successful-source and target-positive cohorts differ between models and recipes.
Equal attempted trial counts do not imply equal queries, runtime, or compute; actual query use is unrecorded.
Subset outcomes reuse saved attacks and audited predictions; they are not held-out selection outcomes.
Conditional subset means require every selected model to have a defined conditional macro rate.
